summary: Preserve public class field descriptor attributes when object reflection/enumeration is observable.

target.notes: Represent the field as an own JavaScript data property with writable/enumerable/configurable all true.

caveats: A CLR field cannot be deleted and does not participate in Object.keys without an object-model layer.

tests.name: edge: field configurable
tests.input: class C { x=1; } const c=new C(); console.log(delete c.x, 'x' in c);
